## Book chapter

This week we will be covering [Chapter 3: Simple linear regression – Part 1](https://opetchey.github.io/BIO144_Course_Book/3.1-regression-part1.html) of the course book.

## Video and code walkthrough

Each chapter of the course book has a code walkthrough: an R script with the code of the chapter, with comments explaining each step, and a video in which Owen works through the script. Use them to learn the R code you need this week. Work through them before the practical, ideally running the script line by line while you watch the video. The last section of the script ("Practical toolbox") shows code that the practical uses but the chapter does not.

**Script:** [walkthrough_ch03_regression_part1.R](https://opetchey.github.io/BIO144_Course_Book/walkthroughs/walkthrough_ch03_regression_part1.R)

To download the script straight into your RStudio project folder (for example on RStudio Server), run this line in the Console:

`download.file("https://opetchey.github.io/BIO144_Course_Book/walkthroughs/walkthrough_ch03_regression_part1.R", destfile = "walkthrough_ch03_regression_part1.R")`

**Video:** coming soon. <!-- VIDEO PLACEHOLDER: replace "coming soon." with the link, e.g. [Watch the video walkthrough](https://youtu.be/XXXX) -->
